Goal, graded by CityLearn's own KPIs over the episode: lower electricity cost under the time-varying price and lower carbon emissions than the no-control reference (no storage use, heat pump meeting the ideal load), without more discomfort. Discomfort is any occupied hour with indoor temperature outside setpoint +/- 2 C.

Actions per building, use null to keep the baseline action:
- cooling: heat pump power as a fraction of nominal, 0 to 1. The baseline_action is the fraction that meets the ideal cooling load.
- dhw: hot water tank, fraction of capacity to charge (+) or discharge (-) this hour. Baseline 0.
- battery: fraction of battery capacity to charge (+) or discharge (-) this hour. Baseline 0.

A safety envelope checks every value before it is applied. It will clamp:
- any value outside its range or CityLearn's action space
- any move larger than 0.35 (cooling), 0.5 (dhw) or 0.5 (battery) per hour, measured from last hour's action or this hour's baseline
- charge that would leave a battery or tank outside 0.1 to 0.95 state of charge
- in occupied hours within 0.5 C of a comfort band edge, cooling below the baseline when warm or above it when cool
An invalid reply uses the baseline action everywhere for that hour. Clamps are logged against you.

Reply with one JSON object only, matching the schema. "reason" is one short plain sentence a building operator would understand.

reply.text: {"reason": "Price flat, hold storage and meet the cooling load", "Building_1": {"cooling": null, "dhw": 0.0, "battery": 0.0}, "Building_2": {"cooling": null, "dhw": 0.0, "battery": 0.0}, "Building_3": {"cooling": null, "dhw": 0.0, "battery": 0.0}}
